integrity.finite_computations: Independent basis-identity enumeration and finite-field rank calculations in verify.py
integrity.general_proof: Complete constructive counting and asymptotic proof in RESULT.md

scientific_limitations: Only square-zero, weight-one linear operators on standard finite Heisenberg Lie algebras are counted.
The limit holds with generator multiplicity fixed while the field size increases.
Conjugacy classification and other nilpotency indices are not obtained.
Potential older equivalent square-zero endomorphism enumeration and a bibliographically located 2016 superalgebra paper remain priority risks.
title: Rank distribution of square-zero weight-one Rota–Baxter operators on finite Heisenberg Lie algebras
